## Body

The #318 and #321 AFTER notes are governed commits 25d142ad and 59236faa, respectively, with complete numeric endpoint receipts and explicit proof ceilings. Both ran on PID96429 / deployed 3c14199f5150a24333fc227d7dca38d9ea072a65, read-only, without builds, bounce, artificial traffic or direct production SQLite access.

For future comparisons: a matched protocol is not a matched workload. #313's 213 decision panes became 134; #321 whoami demand fell from 520/501 to 122/113 per minute. Record load, process start/age, instrument times and request/pane cohorts before attributing CPU. Keep the co-deployed observer's captures/skips/backstops separate from SQLite/Tokio CPU and whoami wall-time stages. Never divide all daemon CPU by one route's call count and call it that route's unit cost.

Current observer ping telemetry has no drain/repair/capture-cause counters. Aggregate captures minus backstops cannot recover D or R. Flat attachment-launch counters show no counted attachment launch, not a cause attribution. Observer counters omit injection-owned captures and failed attempts.

Retain raw ping edges and per-thread/ps endpoints from the outset: result-only summaries can verify arithmetic, not reconstruct a missing BEFORE cohort or exited thread. Pool round-trip counts apply per warm clean reused lease, not every transaction/store-call shape.

magicWand: a single read-only cost-receipt verb that keeps per-instrument monotonic endpoints, PID/build/start/age, cohort, thread samples and lease/worker counts, with the busy machine launch probe outside CPU windows.
difficulties: absent cause telemetry; demand/load/co-deployment confounding; BEFORE raw endpoints missing; full code gates unavailable in dependency-free read-only measurement trees. No new source tooling was added by this measurement assignment.
